name: @equin/plugin-database-client-tools
description: Postgres client tools (pg_dump, pg_restore) from the same release as the embedded server.

wraps.name: PostgreSQL
wraps.prerequisite: the daily auto-publish of github.com/equinai/pg-client-embedded has not published @equin/pg-client-* for PostgreSQL <version>: check its latest Build and Publish run (`gh run list -R equinai/pg-client-embedded -w 'Build and Publish'`; `gh workflow enable` it if GitHub disabled it after 60 days without activity), fix it and re-run, then upgrade

groups.reason: pg_dump / pg_restore must come from the same Postgres release (major.minor) as the embedded server
groups.prerequisite: the daily auto-publish of github.com/equinai/pg-client-embedded has not published @equin/pg-client-* for the new @embedded-postgres release: check its latest Build and Publish run (`gh run list -R equinai/pg-client-embedded -w 'Build and Publish'`; `gh workflow enable` it if GitHub disabled it after 60 days without activity), fix it and re-run, then upgrade again — the two move together
